purpose: Final engineering semantic retrieval gate for the working UC3 embedding configuration.
scope: Engineering retrieval-configuration qualification only. This is not a benchmark result.
PROBE_COUNT_ADAPTATION: prospectively adapted from 8 to 9 because UC3 has 9 accepted documents
methodological_note: The UC1 core semantic-diagnostic design is preserved (top-k, repeats, expected-document measure, benchmark separation, and prospective acceptance-gate logic), while probe count is prospectively adapted for complete UC3 document coverage.
source_basis: Probe targets and purpose paraphrases are derived only from pre-existing non-retrieval metadata in corpus/use_cases/UC3/source_selection.tsv, corpus/use_cases/UC3/eligibility_review.tsv, corpus/use_cases/UC3/README.md, and corpus/use_cases/UC3/benchmark_scope.json.

design.query_style: Semantic purpose paraphrases. Prohibited in every query: canonical titles, aliases (DigComp, RFCDC, DigCompEdu, DigCompOrg), document IDs, URLs, DOIs, JRC identifiers, OJ/CELEX/legal citations, and phrases that are effectively the canonical title with minor grammatical changes.
design.expected_target: Rank of the first retrieved chunk belonging to the pre-specified expected document.

engineering_acceptance_gate.note: These are pre-specified engineering sufficiency criteria, not thesis outcome metrics. Thresholds scale the UC1 v0.1 gate (7/6/4/7 out of 8) to the UC3 probe count of 9 using CEILING.
engineering_acceptance_gate.threshold_rationale: Thresholds were prospectively scaled from the frozen UC1 gate using ceil(UC3_probe_count * UC1_threshold / UC1_probe_count) before any UC3 diagnostic execution or result observation.
